method: All identified complete salary pages rendered directly from the exact originals by PyMuPDF page.get_pixmap(dpi=300,alpha=False). Raw RGB pixel hashes retained; source texttrace painting guards cover all native spans for invisible/white/transparent text. This is not an OCR transcription or a claim of manual reading of every glyph. Source-image visual checks and independent full PDFMiner row reading are recorded separately.
